## Problem

What handoff-readiness problem is not covered well today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest deterministic behavior that would help.

## Evidence

Provide public examples, common repository conventions, or repeated real-world cases that justify the change.

## Scope boundary

Explain why this belongs in a local deterministic Action rather than an AI reviewer, hosted service, or production compliance tool.
